title: Unbreakability
description: A mod that adds unbreakable stuff to the game, and a fun way to break them.
body:
![TITLE](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f667e89c583def41a99eae5c354c90e1ee24cf7.png)

Hey! im back with another mod,
UNBREAKABILITY!

Unbreakability adds:

**Resistant Plated Block**

![RPB](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/862c925244bc705619cab60fd5c5dbc4badcca13.png)

**Resistant Door**

![RD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82dc4531aafbcce2af6b530b07845006630f437e.png)

And a weapon to destroy it

**THE BOOT**

![THE BOOT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa58112b009c10287ddff7383f101baae8d849a7.png)
